mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_history(user_id, user_chat, ai_chat) VALUES (#{userId}, #{userChat}, #{aiChat})
mapper.select: SELECT ch.no AS no, user_id AS userId, user_chat AS userChat, ai_chat AS aiChat, ch.create_at AS createAt, ch.favorite AS favorite, GROUP_CONCAT(h.tag_text ORDER BY h.tag_text SEPARATOR ',') AS tags FROM chat_history ch LEFT OUTER JOIN hashtag h ON ch.no = h.no WHERE user_id = #{id} GROUP BY ch.no, ch.user_id, ch.user_chat, ch.ai_chat, ch.create_at, ch.favorite ORDER BY ch.create_at DESC
